title: Chinese New Year (var)
author: Chris Page
problems: Row 1 "balance & box circulate - robins cross while larks loop right · balance": two dancers come within 0.47 m of each other.
choices: Give & take: half the beats to cross, half to back home holding both hands.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
